title: Determination of seismic design category.
officialText:
All structures shall be assigned to a seismic design category based on their risk category determined in accordance with Table 1604.5 and the design spectral response acceleration parameters S and S , DS D1 determined in accordance with Section 1613.5.4 or the site-specific procedures of ASCE 7-10. Each building and structure shall be assigned to the more severe seismic design category in accordance with Table 1613.5.6(1) or 1613.5.6(2), irrespective of the fundamental period of vibration of the structure, T.

SEISMIC DESIGN CATEGORY BASED ON SHORT-PERIOD (0.2 SECOND) RESPONSE ACCELERATIONS

City Building Code as such categories do not apply in New York City. References to these Seismic Design Categories can be found in ASCE 7-10.
